chen: heads-up, saw non-monotonic attention outputs when we switch from 2k->8k context on rw-7b-v1-quant after the recent int8 kernel bump. outputs diverge after ~3072 tokens, not just slow drift, looks like kv misalignment.

alice: ugh. regression after the quant kernel change? any repro + seed?

chen: minimal repro attached below. happens with both prefix-append and streamed incremental decoding. run:```python
# repro snippet
from rwd_serving import Client
c = Client(model='rw-7b-v1-quant', kv_mode='continuous')
prompt = 'A'*3500 + ' The quick brown fox'
out1 = c.generate(prompt, max_tokens=32, seed=42)
# then truncate prompt to 2000 and append again
prompt2 = 'A'*2000 + 'A'*1500 + ' The quick brown fox'
out2 = c.generate(prompt2, max_tokens=32, seed=42)
print(out1==out2)
```

chen: prints False, and token-level logits mismatch starting at token ~3076.

ben: can you paste the kv index logs? i want the index offsets and rot-phase info.

chen: snippet from runtime log (trimmed):```
[2026-02-27T18:12:34Z] kv_store: write idx start=0 end=3072 slot_offset=0
[2026-02-27T18:12:34Z] attn_kernel: rotary_phase=0.8743 scale=1.000
[2026-02-27T18:12:52Z] kv_store: write idx start=3072 end=8192 slot_offset=3072
[2026-02-27T18:12:52Z] attn_kernel: rotary_phase=0.8743 scale=0.999
[2026-02-27T18:13:03Z] kv_store: read idx start=256 end=3328
[2026-02-27T18:13:03Z] attn_kernel: rotary_phase=0.8701 scale=0.995
```

chen: note the phase drift ~0.004 between writes/reads even though same model config. suspect quantized kernel uses fast trig aprox that accumulates error across chunks.

dave: interesting. did you try forcing full-precision rotary on the int8 run? iirc we have a compile flag to keep rope in fp16.

chen: yes — toggling ROPE_FP_MODE to fp16 in the config makes outputs converge (out1==out2 True). cost increase small for this model but rules out longctx memory corruption.

alice: good signal. can we run a quick diff across 3 seeds and two prompt shapes? i'll queue a tiny bench. @bench-bot can you run? :pray:

bench-bot: queued test rw-7b-v1-quant: 3 seeds x (continuous vs chunked) x (2k->8k vs 8k direct). CI id: ci-2026-02-27-4721. will post results when done. :gear:

ben: also check case where we prefill with prefix caching (prefix length ~3072) then rotate by appending 4096 token block. i suspect index arithmetic in kv-shift for chunk boundaries.

chen: i added a small unit test in eng-ml/kv_tests that simulates slot_offset misalign:```py
# test_kv_align.py
store = KVMock(slot_size=1024)
# write 3 slots
store.write(blocks=[0,1,2])
# simulate shader rounding
store.slot_offset += 1  # rounding bug
out = store.read(range(256, 3072))
assert out.start == 256  # currently fails, returns 512
```

alice: thanks. if bench shows consistent repro we'll try: (1) force ROPE fp fallback, (2) add slot_offset sanity check in kv_store, (3) add micro regression to quant int8 kernel tests.

dave: also file to eng-releases if this needs a hotfix. might affect dedicated customers using long context with int8.

chen: agree. next steps: i'll attach full CI logs once bench-bot finishes, and open a draft PR with the ROPE_FP_MODE toggle + extra sanity-check asserts. in the meantime, tagging @alice for triage. :mag:
